The text outlines a clear chain of events driven by cause-and-effect relationships. The primary cause is an unexpected power outage, which directly resulted in the servers going offline. This server failure then caused a shutdown of all digital operations for the company. The consequence of this operational shutdown was that global clients were affected, which in turn led to two specific outcomes: contractual penalties and a dip in the company's stock price.
